bookings_intro: Book a resource over a period. The database refuses two overlapping bookings of the same resource, whatever the interface lets through.
warning_overlap: This period overlaps: {labels}. The server will refuse it.
conflict_refused: Refused by the server: the resource is already booked over part of this period ({labels}).
demo_unavailable: The demo's database could not start in this browser. Reload the page; if it happens again, try another browser.
server_unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
demo_service_worker_unavailable: The demo runs entirely in your browser and needs a service worker, which this window does not allow (private browsing, for example). Open the demo in a normal window or in another browser.
